name: slide-studio
description: Claude Code skill: research-to-deck pipeline that produces pptx / pdf with quality gates (headline-as-conclusion, one message per slide, sources on every page).
author: Haruki Inoue

scripts.smoke: node evals/smoke.js default .out/smoke && python3 scripts/validate_pptx.py .out/smoke/smoke-default.pptx && python3 scripts/check_layout.py .out/smoke/smoke-default.manifest.json
scripts.smoke:all: for t in default mono navy editorial; do node evals/smoke.js $t .out/smoke && python3 scripts/validate_pptx.py .out/smoke/smoke-$t.pptx && python3 scripts/check_layout.py .out/smoke/smoke-$t.manifest.json || exit 1; done
scripts.test: npm run contrast && npm run smoke:all
